codelines.name: gotransit
codelines.reason: Implements the Go-Checkout page's Email and Confirm Email fields, including the exact case-sensitive comparison the ticket describes.
codelines.evidence: src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/CheckoutForm.tsx:306 — `validate: (value: string) => { if (email && value && value !== email) { return t("TRM774"); } }` — a strict `!==` comparison with no case normalization, matching the ticket's description of an email-casing mismatch on the Checkout page's Email/Confirm Email fields.

facts.text: Tests run via `jest` (npm run test); `test:coverage-check` runs `jest --coverage` after `npm run build:config`.
A pre-commit hook (husky) runs `npx lint-staged` and then rejects the commit unless the current branch name matches `^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)\/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(\/[a-z0-9-]+)?$`.
lint-staged runs `npm run check-types` on any staged .ts/.tsx file, plus eslint and prettier --write on staged .ts/.js/.tsx/.jsx files.
